title: Small tips, not for frosting cupcakes
text: Small tips, not for frosting cupcakes. This is a nice little set. I bought it in a hurry to decorate cupcakes for my son’s first birthday. This set has smaller openings so I’d say they were more geared towards fun details on cakes. I needed a wide opening and none of the provided tips were wide enough. I made due because I was out of time to order more.
